This evening, salute to our senior planner
The new month is here
Friendly paws, steady flights

The Companion Animal Travel Desk has been busy with calm checks, cleaner carrier spaces, and kinder handoffs at the gate. Travelers have been telling us they feel more at ease when the team talks through each step, and that steady attention keeps the whole trip moving in a smoother way. <<FACT F010>> Staff are also staying alert for small hazards, from loose straps to nervous pets, so every journey starts with a quick, practical look at what could go wrong and how to prevent it.

At Thornwick, <<FACT F004>> that care shows up in the pet lounge, where the mood stays welcoming and the guidance stays clear. If a passenger feels worried, our supervisors listen closely and respond with simple help, not fuss. That is the kind of dependable companion travel Aurelia Skyways wants to offer every day, and it is making a real difference for people traveling with pets. Companion Animal Travel Desk
